items.title: Tree of Life — LTAV school logo
items.body: PEACEVERSE – School Logo Selection Result Liceul Teoretic “Aurel Vlaicu”, Breaza, Romania This is our school's selected PEACEVERSE logo, chosen following an internal school competition held in October 2026. The image depicts the Tree of Life with glowing roots and branches, surrounded by a circular design and a dove, symbolising peace, connection, shared growth and hope.  Selection method: internal LTAV school competition. The exact voting date, student creator credit and number of votes have not been supplied for this post; these details can be added if available.  This is our SCHOOL selection, not the final international project winner.  Visual credit: school-submitted logo artwork; AI credits ChatGPT. Shared by Livia Epure for LTAV on 10 November 2026.

items.title: A Place for Every Memory — shared story
items.body:
PEACEVERSE – November Shared Heritage & Peace Story
Liceul Teoretic “Aurel Vlaicu”, Breaza, Romania
Teacher: Livia Epure
Team: Anamaria I., David P., Paula S., Stefania N., Adelina B., Larisa S.

A PLACE FOR EVERY MEMORY

When the notebook reached the next group, Mira found a pressed flower between its pages. Tomas suggested drawing the same flower on every leaf of their paper tree. A quiet classmate shook her head. “My grandmother stitched a different pattern,” she said, showing a small blue flower in her family notebook.

“Then let us make room for yours,” Mira replied. They placed the patterns side by side and asked what each one meant. Nobody had to erase a memory to belong. When they disagreed about a colour, they tried both and listened to the reasons behind each choice. By evening, their tree carried many different leaves. Beside the bridge, they left a blank space in the notebook and a question for the next school: “Which memory would you like us to hear?”

Shared Canva story (LTAV pages 13–14): https://www.canva.com/design/DAHZrCbngoo/edit

Caption: “Fiecare amintire are loc pe podul dintre noi.”

Credits: LTAV team contribution coordinated by Livia Epure, with AI-assisted editorial support. Illustration included in the shared Canva story. Published on 10 November 2026. The story is fictional.

LOCAL HERITAGE REFERENCE (teacher-researched contextual source; not part of the fictional story): The blue embroidered flower and family textile memory in this chapter provide an opportunity to explore Breaza’s traditional embroidered blouse, the “ia de Breaza”. The Breaza Tourist Information Centre documents its changing materials, colours and embroidery motifs from the nineteenth century onward. This source supports the local textile-heritage context; it does not establish that the fictional grandmother’s pattern is an authenticated historical design.

Source: Breaza Tourist Information Centre, “Tradiții și meșteșuguri în Breaza – Ia de Breaza”:
https://infoturismbreaza.ro/ro/ia-de-breaza/

PREVIOUS PROJECT REFERENCE (not current PEACEVERSE evidence): “Breaza Traditional Blouse – Romanian Cultural Heritage”, created in 2025–2026 for the eTwinning project “Digital World Culture and Language Workshop”, which received a National Quality Label. Previous project team: Mălina C., Alexandra T., Alex P. and David P.; coordinator: Livia E. Photo credit: Mrs Alexandra C., Prăvălia cu ii, Breaza.
